title: LA Colossal – Vermilion Najeon 06 (Seated)
prompt:

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips spreading across the stool, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body najeon-chilgi body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, not latex. Deep glossy vermilion lacquer clearly different from skin, inlaid with iridescent mother-of-pearl lotus and mandarin ducks. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Seated upright on a round lacquer stool, torso facing the camera, legs crossed at the knee, both hands resting lightly on her upper knee with elbows relaxed out. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Towering 9-inch vermilion lacquer platform gladiator stiletto sandals laced to mid-calf with pearl eyelets.
Nails: Extra long coffin nails, coral red.

Background & Lighting: Palace corridor with red columns and hanging silk lanterns, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm lantern light with raking side light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
